_comment: The rules the curation runs on, set by New Life. These are editorial judgements, not data problems, so they live in one place where they can be read and argued with rather than buried in a script.

scope.reaches: Rockford, Sparta, Cedar Springs, Lowell, Caledonia, Byron Center, Hudsonville, Allendale, Coopersville

knappsCorner.note: Churches sharing our own campus. A prayer or worship gathering here is ours to point at; the same gathering across town competes with what we already do.

noOverlapWithOurSignature.note: We already do these well. Carrying somebody else's version divides our own people rather than adding anything. Sunday morning is the clearest case: our own service, our own kids ministry.

sundayMorningIsOurs.note: Anything on a Sunday morning competes with our own service and our own children's ministry, whatever it is called. Sunday School and Sunday-morning kids programmes go with it.

oursByName.note: Things we run ourselves whatever day they fall on. Nursery and childcare are ours; a parent looking for those is looking for our building.

traditionsToAvoid.note: Kept off unless a category has no other option at all, in which case the best available is carried and flagged.

alwaysExclude.note: Churches held off this site for a reason worth writing down. Bauer Christian Reformed was asked for by name. Coit Community Church is a real Christian Reformed church whose Church Map record currently carries Sunshine Community Church's website and calendar feed, so its events are not its own; confirmed by The Church Map, Aug 2026. Remove this line once their feed is corrected, and Coit becomes a candidate like any other.

charismatic.note: Lean toward churches whose own language and tradition sit close to ours, where there is a choice.

midweekDispersion.note: Midweek is where geography decides whether a family can actually go, so spread these across the map rather than stacking them downtown.

needsHumanHandling.note: Flagged by New Life for a person to decide rather than a rule.

junkRecords.note: Two test rows on The Church Map are flagged approved=true and do reach public surfaces. The other seventeen are already excluded upstream and need no filter here. Verified against live prod, Aug 2026; remove these once the flags are corrected at source.

schoolCalendarNoise.note: School term dates that ride along in a parish calendar. Not a gathering anyone turns up to.

specialisedOnly.note: The line: a category area stays in the curated browse if at least one ministry in it publishes dates we can carry. If nobody does, it moves to the specialised list. That is self-maintaining — as curation fills an area, it comes back on its own. The list below forces an area onto the shelf even when it does have offerings.
specialisedOnly.rule: an area with zero offerings is specialised

venueAliases.note: Records that carry the same congregation under more than one name, so one ministry does not appear twice. Blythefield Hills was renamed Magnify Church and both names survived across two campuses. Coit and Sunshine are deliberately NOT aliased: they are separate records at separate addresses and that is The Church Map's question to settle, not ours.

prayedFor.note: Churches New Life has prayed for by name in a prayer journey on The Church Map. A warmer starting point for partnership conversations than calendar quality, because the relationship already has something real in it.

churchCenter.note: Planning Center Church Center is readable but their Terms of Service forbid it, and their robots.txt disallows Anthropic agents by name. Closed by The Church Map in docs/plans/church-center-calendar-findings.md. The legitimate route is a registered OAuth app the church authorises. Do not re-derive the token handshake.

websitesTheMapIsMissing.note: Three prayed-for churches had no website on their Church Map record, and none of them could be found by guessing a domain from the name. Every one uses a domain that does not match what it calls itself — which is why an automated crawl misses them and a person finds them in seconds.

found.why: They were Life Center Church and kept the old domain after the rebrand.
found.extra: Meets at 2777 Knapp St NE — our own building — Sundays at 3:30pm.
Kids Club Sunday 6pm for grades 1-5, youth group Monday 7:30pm for grades 6-12.

found.why: Their domain is an initialism, mccgr.
